responsibility: Implements the out-of-line range-transfer helpers for GCC integer value-range reasoning on wide_int bounds. This file belongs to the fold/range analysis support layer and computes conservative result intervals and bit facts for tree integer operations, including cross-product evaluation for multiplicative operators, wrapping multiplication, shift and bitwise range refinement, abs/absv-like transforms, truncating conversion, modulo, and division handling that can split results around division-by-zero while respecting signedness, precision, overflow-undefined semantics, and non-call-exception constraints via cfun. It consumes tree_code operations plus lower/upper wide_int endpoints and produces narrowed result bounds and related masks used by VRP/folding code.
same_name_distinction: Defines the out-of-line implementations of the wide_int range helpers declared in wide-int-range.h, including the core algorithms for cross-product arithmetic, wrapping/overflow-aware multiplicative operations, bit-mask derivation, conversions, abs handling, and division splitting around zero with cfun non-call-exception checks.
